[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]not by being dropped.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Planner prompt-archive rows use linked (page-only) scope[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]planner-scope[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]planner-scope: planner approvals enqueue their prompt-archive row with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]linked scope, and enqueue merges keep revision scope when either side [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]has it, so the revision gate stops refusing rows for commits the planner[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]never made.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Report the real refusal reason and retire repeated refusals[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]honest-errors[dim] · [dim][/dim]after planner-scope[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]honest-errors: gate refusals record the Rust completion decision's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reason instead of "did not materialize", the dead retire-on-repeat path [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]works again, and the stale-revision doctor hint stops recommending a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]repair that cannot apply.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop re-scanning already-published bytes on every hood publish[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]hood-scan-reuse[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hood-scan-reuse: targeted hood publication skips the protection scan for[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bytes identical to the previously published file reference, which brings[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the research hood back under the 120s drain budget.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Deferred restore rebuilds the plan-named planner archive [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF](sase-1c0)[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]planner-restore[dim] · [dim][/dim]after planner-scope[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]planner-restore: persist the planner archive inputs in the planner's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]artifacts directory so a deferred restore rebuilds the same plan-named [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]archive with its PLAN link, then close sase-1c0.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Parse bracketed footer values that lack a link definition[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]footer-brackets[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]footer-brackets: the sase-core commit-footer parser unwraps [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`SASE_BEAD=\[id]` values that have no reference definition, and sase [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rebuilds the cached stitch-rule rows, so the `bead:[...]` warning stops [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]appearing in digests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Report-first re-scope repair for proven planner rows[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]planner-repair[dim] · [dim][/dim]after honest-errors[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]planner-repair: add a report-first `sase agent sync [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]--repair-planner-scopes` mode that re-scopes only evidence-proven [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]planner rows to linked through the outbox mutation API, with an audit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Clear the already-stuck planner and research rows[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]stuck-row-cleanup[dim] · [dim][/dim]after hood-scan-reuse, planner-repair[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]stuck-row-cleanup: once the fixes are live, re-scope proven planner rows[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and retry each targeted row by key, then verify that every one cleared [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through acknowledgment with its pages and archives intact.[/#D7D7AF]
